fixedFindings.finding: The Android NUSA decision hero translated canonical AI status AVAILABLE into VERIFIED, which could overstate the meaning of the canonical projection.
fixedFindings.resolution: Render the canonical AI status token directly and use UNAVAILABLE only when no status exists.

fixedFindings.finding: The Android NUSA decision hero used fixed horizontal layouts without the large-font/compact-window stacking already required for physical-device QA.
fixedFindings.resolution: Use useWindowDimensions and stack title/header/confidence/facts when width < 430 or fontScale >= 1.35; add contract assertions.

fixedFindings.finding: The Android Home labeled every canonical AI AVAILABLE state as 새 판단 even though the projection does not establish that the judgment is newly arrived.
fixedFindings.resolution: Use the neutral label NUSA 판단 and guard against unsupported recency wording in the Android D contract test.
fixedFindings.scopeCorrection: Commit b942ed39e00e42f98f5e56bffc3fe4f846a41cdf removed an incidental visual-only opacity drift introduced while applying the wording fix, leaving the intended Home behavior change limited to the status wording.

staticAudit.note: Static inspection reduces known repository-side defects but is not a substitute for required Node24/pnpm/Gradle validation or physical-device acceptance.

accidentalPreValidationPr.note: Accidentally opened before required machine validation and closed immediately. Its workflow results are not valid pre-PR validation evidence and must not be used to justify merge or release.
